description: Keep agents moving when they stop only to ask for an unnecessary confirmation. Jev reviews the complete available top-level conversation whenever a thread becomes idle and continues only when its Noul value exceeds 0.95. Before sending `please proceed`, it confirms that the thread is still idle and has no pending interaction or queued message, then stops if the same final response repeats. Use a TypeSafe, Vercel AI Gateway, or OpenRouter API key; conversation text is sent through the selected provider for TypeSafe processing, and usage charges may apply.
